rca of the issue: Original user complaint was that submitting a testimonial didn't show it on homepage. RCA: this is intentional anti-spam — testimonials are saved as status='pending' and require owner moderation. Mitigation already in place: (1) /api/sidebar/badges now returns testimonials_pending count; (2) sidebar entry '⭐ مراجعة شهادات العملاء' has a green badge showing the count so the owner is alerted; (3) TestimonialSubmitPage shows a thank-you message explaining moderation takes 24-48h. Verified end-to-end in preview. User still needs to deploy this change to production and approve their own pending testimonial via the moderation UI.
